text:
elaine: Heads-up — found two orphaned KMS wrapping keys still referenced by an old Vault transit mount after last week's DB creds migration. audit logs don't show rewraps for those secrets. can we coordinate a safe cleanup + RBAC tweak?

raj: thanks, can you drop key ids and the vault path?

elaine: key ids: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/wrap-old-1 and .../wrap-old-2. vault path: transit/legacy-db-wrap. I ran `vault list transit/legacy-db-wrap/keys` and it shows the wrapped ciphertext still references those key ids.

maria: :eyes: do we know if any active tokens/services still call that mount? last week we cutover apps but some long-lived jobs might still use it.

elaine: quick grep across repos showed a couple of scheduled tasks in `infra/cron` referencing `transit/legacy-db-wrap` (cron-exporter, nightly-backup). I flagged the two jobs.

liam: short checklist proposal: 1) snapshot audit logs query for any decrypt/rewrap activity for the two keys 2) prevent new writes to transit/legacy-db-wrap (make it read-only) 3) create new wrapping keys + rewrap ciphertext 4) rotate any long-lived tokens and update IAM RBAC to remove legacy key access 5) retire old keys after a 7-day canary.

zach: ok can own step 3 and 5. I'll create new keys in the same keyring and perform rewraps. plan to use `gcloud kms keys versions create --key` and then `gcloud kms encrypt` flows plus `vault write transit/legacy-db-wrap/rewrap ciphertext=...`.

maria: i'll handle step 1 and the token audit. quick query I'll run: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" AND protoPayload.request.name:(wrap-old-1 OR wrap-old-2)" --limit 1000`

elaine: note: audit logs for Vault -> KMS calls are routed through the service account `svc-vault-kms@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. if that SA shows decrypts after the cutoff timestamp, pause.

raj: RBAC change: propose a short-lived IAM role binding removal for `wrap-old-*` keys to reduce blast radius during rewrap. We can remove `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` from any non-essential principals, keep it for `svc-vault-kms` and `zach`/`ops-sa` while rewrap runs. then re-add if needed.

liam: agree. also add an audit-only policy for Vault to log rewrap actions explicitly: enable `audit` level on transit mount for this window.

zach: timeline estimate: 30m to create keys + test rewrap on a sample ciphertext, 45m to rewrap all queued objects, 1h buffer for validation. will do during low-traffic window (03:00 UTC).

maria: i'll publish a quickcorral doc and run a `gcloud` log query for the last 30 days and post results here. also will rotate any service tokens found referencing the mount.

elaine: can someone trigger a short canary to validate application decrypts after rewrap? cron-exporter owner is @sara — @sara can you confirm a one-off run after we flip?

sec-bot: Incident watcher: scheduled maintenance window registered: start=2248010800 end=2248012600 subject="vault-kms rewrap". Pager notifications suppressed for infra group.

raj: @sara asked to delay until 08:00 PST. that's fine. let's lock RBAC changes to a 30m window before rewrap and keep an emergency rollback plan to re-import old keys (we should snapshot the old key material envelope).

zach: noted — will export old key metadata using `gcloud kms keys versions get-public-key` and store envelope in `gs://redwood-sec-backups/wrap-old-archive/` with restricted ACLs.

elaine: final owner map: liam = coordinator, zach = rewrap+retire, maria = audit+token rotations, raj = RBAC changes, sara = canary run. I'll open a short internal ticket and post the runbook. everyone ok?

maria: ok from me.

raj: ok.

zach: ready.

elaine: thanks all — I'll send calendar invite and add the runbook link here once created.

sre-oncall: FYI if anything breaks, toggle `VAULT_TRANSIT_LEGACY_READONLY=true` on canary pods to force fallback to new mount.

elaine: posted runbook: https://internal.redwood/docs/runbooks/vault-kms-rewrap-2248005012 (internal link). planning to start 08:00 PST tomorrow.

zach: added terraform snippet to ops PR to create the new keys: ```hcl
resource "google_kms_crypto_key" "wrap_new" {
  name     = "wrap-new-1"
  key_ring = "projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra"
  rotation_period = "2592000s"
}
```
elaine: perfect — will mark thread as the canonical coordination channel. once rewrap done, paste verification `vault read transit/legacy-db-wrap/status` output here. :thumbsup:
